questions.explanation_correct: The Standard Missile family (SM-1, SM-2, SM-6) provides the backbone of US naval air defense.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sea Sparrow is short-range; Tomahawk and Harpoon are primarily for surface attack.

questions.question: Which US Navy heavyweight torpedo is designated Mark 48?
questions.explanation_correct: The Mark 48 is the US Navy's primary heavyweight torpedo used by submarines. It is designed for anti-ship and anti-submarine missions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other Mark numbers are torpedoes too, but they are different lightweight or later models. They do not correspond to the heavyweight Mark 48.

questions.question: The M998 HMMWV, developed by AM General for the US military, is universally known by which name?
questions.explanation_correct: Humvee is a phonetic derivation of the HMMWV (High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle) acronym.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Jeep was its predecessor; JLTV is its modern replacement; M998 is a specific model number.

questions.question: Which NATO reporting name was assigned to the Tupolev Tu-22M swing-wing long-range bomber?
questions.explanation_correct: The Tu-22M Backfire was designed for maritime strike and strategic bombing during the Cold War.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bear is the Tu-95, Blackjack is the Tu-160, and Badger is the Tu-16.

questions.question: Which rocket-propelled grenade launcher family is designated RPG-7?
questions.explanation_correct: RPG-7 is the widely used Soviet-era rocket-propelled grenade launcher family. It has seen service in many armies and conflicts worldwide.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are infantry weapons, but they are not the RPG-7 launcher family. Some are older launchers or different Russian weapon systems entirely.

questions.question: What is the name of the US Navy's radar-guided 20mm Gatling gun system used to destroy incoming missiles?
questions.explanation_correct: The Phalanx CIWS is colloquially known as 'R2-D2' due to its distinct white dome.
questions.explanation_incorrect: SeaRAM uses missiles; Goalkeeper is Dutch-made; Crotale is a French missile system.

questions.question: Which British tank name is associated with a World War II heavy tank?
questions.explanation_correct: Churchill was the name of a British heavy tank used during World War II. It is one of the best-known British tank names from that era.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also British tank names, but they refer to different models. They are not the specific heavy tank named in the question.

questions.question: Which designer surname is associated with the AR-15 family of rifles?
questions.explanation_correct: Eugene Stoner designed the AR-10 and AR-15 platforms. His surname is strongly associated with these rifles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other names are famous firearms designers, but they are not tied to the AR-15 family. They represent different weapons and design lineages.

questions.question: Which nickname is commonly linked to the F-104 interceptor?
questions.explanation_correct: The Lockheed F-104 is commonly known as the Starfighter. That nickname is widely used in aviation history.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are nicknames for different fighter aircraft. They do not identify the F-104.

questions.question: Which weapon name refers to a well-known American submachine gun from the 1920s?
questions.explanation_correct: The Thompson submachine gun is a classic American firearm introduced in the early 20th century. It is one of the most recognizable SMGs in history.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are submachine guns too, but they are different models from other countries or periods. They are not the Thompson.

questions.question: Which European attack helicopter model name was developed jointly by France and Germany?
questions.explanation_correct: The Eurocopter Tiger is a European attack helicopter developed by France and Germany. Its model name is Tiger.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are attack helicopter models as well, but they are not the French-German design. They belong to different programs and countries.

questions.question: Which German battleship class name was shared by two ships built in the 1930s?
questions.explanation_correct: Scharnhorst was the name of a German battleship class that included Scharnhorst and Gneisenau. It is a notable prewar German capital-ship class.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also German warship names, but they refer to different ships or classes. They are not the class named in the question.

questions.question: Which disposable launcher name is associated with a lightweight anti-tank weapon?
questions.explanation_correct: LAW stands for Light Anti-tank Weapon and is a disposable launcher design. It is meant to be fired once and discarded.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are anti-tank weapons, but they are not the specific disposable launcher named here. They differ in design, role, or reusability.

questions.question: Which American class name is associated with a supercarrier class commissioned in the 1950s?
questions.explanation_correct: The Midway class was a class of American aircraft carriers introduced in the mid-20th century. It included some of the largest carriers of its time.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also U.S. carrier class names, but they identify different classes. They are not the class asked for here.

questions.question: Which rocket launcher name is commonly associated with a Soviet multiple launch artillery system?
questions.explanation_correct: Katyusha is the famous nickname for Soviet multiple rocket launcher systems used during World War II. It became a widely recognized artillery name.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are also rocket artillery systems, but they are different designs from later periods or other countries. They are not Katyusha.

questions.question: The RIM-7 is an American ship-borne short-range anti-aircraft system derived from which air-to-air missile?
questions.explanation_correct: The Sea Sparrow was adapted from the AIM-7 Sparrow to provide point defense for ships.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The others are either large SAMs or cruise/anti-ship missiles with different origins.
